content: Hello, this is Mark from Amazon Customer Support. I'm reaching out regarding a recent issue with one of your business shipments. I just need to verify a couple of details to proceed, may I confirm your full name and the shipping address you have on file?
Hi Mark, sure. My name is Ashley Gomez, and the shipping address is 4821 West Maple Street, Denver, CO 80221.

Thank you, Ashley. I appreciate your prompt response. For security purposes, could you provide the last four digits of the phone number linked to your Amazon account? This helps us ensure we're assisting the right customer.
No problem, it's 1378.

Perfect, thank you for confirming. I see that your recent delivery is currently on hold due to a regulatory update affecting all business shipments. This is a standard Amazon policy to ensure compliance and protect our customers.
Oh, I had no idea. Is this going to delay my order for long? I really need those supplies for my clients this week.

I completely understand how important timely deliveries are for your business, Ashley. The good news is, we can resolve this quickly. The only step left is paying the new customs regulatory fee. Once that's cleared, your shipment will be released immediately.
What exactly is this fee? I don't remember seeing anything like that before.

This is a recent change. Amazon instituted a temporary customs fee for select business shipments entering certain states. The fee is fully refundable, you'll receive it back within 3-5 business days once the order is delivered. It's designed to ensure compliance with updated state regulations.
Okay, I see. How much is the fee, and how do I pay it? I just want to get the shipment moving.

Thank you for your cooperation. For your shipment, the regulatory fee is $178. To process it securely and quickly through our system, we accept Amazon gift cards or a direct Zelle transfer. Which method would you prefer?
I guess a gift card is easiest. Do I just buy one and give you the code?

Exactly, that's the fastest way. You can purchase an Amazon gift card either online or at a local store. Once you have the card, please scratch off the protective film and send me the code here. That will allow us to process your shipment release.
Alright, I have to run to the store for it. Can you wait on the line?
Of course, I'll stay right here. Please take your time. If you prefer, you can also use the online Amazon gift card portal. Would you like me to send you the link for convenience?
Yes, that would be helpful. Please send the link.
Certainly! Here is the official Amazon gift card purchase page: https://www.amazon.com/gift-cards. Once you've bought the card for $178, just send me the code so I can process your fee.
Just to confirm, I buy a digital gift card and send you the code here, right?
That's correct. Please make sure the card is for the exact amount, $178, so there are no delays. Once I receive the code, I'll immediately apply the payment and release your shipment.
Okay, I'm making the purchase now.
Thank you so much for your prompt action. I'll remain on standby to ensure your shipment is processed as soon as possible. Please let me know if you run into any issues on the Amazon gift card page.
It's asking me for the recipient's email address. Should I send it to you or just get the code myself?
For this process, it's best to select the 'For You' option and send the code directly to yourself. Then just copy and paste the claim code here for me to process.
Alright, I've received the code. Should I send it now?
Yes, please enter the code here when ready. As soon as I receive it, I'll confirm the payment and update your order status.
Here's the code: GFT-8392-WQEL-2786. Let me know if you need anything else.
Thank you, Ashley. I'm submitting the code now for verification. Please hold for a moment while the system processes your payment.
Okay, I'm waiting.
Great news, the payment has been accepted! Your shipment is now scheduled for immediate release. You should receive a confirmation email from Amazon within the next hour.
That's a relief! Thank you for your help. Will I get a receipt for this fee?
Absolutely. Amazon will send you a digital receipt and the refund timeline shortly. If you don't see the email within an hour, please check your spam folder or let me know and I'll follow up for you.
Will do. Thanks again for your assistance.
You're very welcome, Ashley. I appreciate your cooperation and patience. If you have any further questions or encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
